outcome: Hemodynamic control (systolic, diastolic, mean arterial pressure)
cohort: The study included 104 patients scheduled for elective Caesarean section.
finding: Prophylactic phenylephrine significantly reduced the incidence of hypotension, nausea, and vomiting compared to therapeutic phenylephrine in patients undergoing elective Caesarean section.
mod_finding: The study found that prophylactic phenylephrine is effective in preventing hypotension, nausea, and vomiting during elective Caesarean sections.
